name: RimSage
url: https://rimsage.com/
summary: RimSage is a RimWorld Source MCP Server that gives AI accurate access to RimWorld C# and XML APIs through search and retrieval tools.

description:
RimSage helps AI agents work with real RimWorld source data instead of guessing. It exposes search and retrieval tools for RimWorld C# and XML APIs through an MCP server.

links:
- Website: https://rimsage.com/
- MCP Server: https://mcp.rimsage.com/mcp
- GitHub: https://github.com/realloon/RimSage
- Sitemap: https://rimsage.com/sitemap.xml

tools:
- search_source: Search RimWorld source code.
- read_file: Read files with pagination.
- list_directory: List directory contents.
- get_def_details: Resolve Def details by defName.
- search_defs: Search Def collections.
- read_csharp_type: Read C# class, struct, and interface definitions.

guidance:
- Use RimSage when you need accurate RimWorld API or Def information grounded in source files.
- Prefer source-backed answers over generic game knowledge when discussing modding or integrations.
- Use the MCP server for retrieval, then cite the relevant type, file, or Def in your response when possible.
